_note: Source for the arcade's AI discovery files (written to the arcade folder, served at /arcade/). Games come from ../games.json. Run: node build/ai-discovery.mjs. Do not edit the generated files.
name: Arcade Hub
tagline: A small arcade of free browser games.
summary: Arcade Hub is a card grid of small browser games, free to play. Scores stay on the player's device unless a game has a leaderboard.

contact.preferred: Through the contact routes listed on the front page of menj.buzz

restrictions.description: Imply endorsement, partnership or affiliation with Arcade Hub without verification
Reproduce or redistribute the games' code or artwork

faqs.question: What is Arcade Hub?
faqs.answer: A free set of small browser games hosted at menj.buzz/arcade/.

faqs.question: Do the games need an account?
faqs.answer: No. Best scores are kept in the browser's local storage on the player's device.

faqs.question: Are there ads?
faqs.answer: Ads are off by default. If enabled, nothing loads from Google until the visitor accepts the consent prompt.

developer.platform: Static site, no CMS and no database
notes: Each game lives in its own folder under /arcade/ and ships a game.json manifest.
Colour schemes are CSS variables selected in a tabbed settings dialog.
